title: Comelec issues subpoenas over alleged ballot-tampering in BARMM polls

blocks.text: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) released subpoenas on Sunday against those alleged to have tampered with ballots for the Bangsamoro parliamentary elections, according to the commission’s budget sponsor, Quezon 4th District Representative Keith Tan.
